blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The tests cover the core cryptographic output, Unicode and nested values, large batches, rotations, CLIs, determinism, and npm test, but do not cover all stated behavior such as empty-batch behavior, tie handling, documented numeric edge cases, omission rules, or manifest field order.

deterministic_tests: The assertions and generated test data are deterministic, but tests/test.sh relies on apt-get and downloading/installing uv from astral.sh, so verifier execution depends on mutable external network resources.

valid_failure_modes: A capable solution can fail for reasons unrelated to the repository task because the verifier performs network-dependent apt and curl installation steps and relies on external package availability.
